option_fast.description: If set to 1, use fast scanning mode.

option_bracket.description: If set to 1, use the alternate bracket policy.

option_overwrite.description: If set to 1, assume it's Ok to overwrite files without asking.

option_desperate.description: If set to 1, switch into desperate mode.

option_verbose.description: If set to 1, print progress messages.

save_file_path.description: Default Save Path for decoded files.

encode_max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines per file for encoding. 0 for unlimited.

encode_encoding.description: Default encoding to use. 0 for UUencoding, 1 for XXencoding, 2 for Base64.
